description.text: This major aims to cultivate a better understanding of Chinese tradition and Chinese culture, and a good feeling towards China; Master the basic knowledge, theories and methods of economics and international economics and trade; Familiar with internationally accepted economic and trade rules, international economic operation mechanisms and development laws; Have certain business data analysis ability, proficient in modern information technology; Good communication, coordination skills and innovative and entrepreneurial spirit; Applied, innovative professionals with a global vision who can engage in international trade and business related work.The basic school system of this major is 4 years, the implementation of 4-6 years flexible school system, students who meet the graduation requirements can be awarded a bachelor's degree in economics.Core courses: Calculus, Microeconomics, Finance, Statistics, International trade, cross-border e-commerce, basic accounting, etc

duration.text: The Accounting at Zhejiang University of Finance and Economics is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2638 USD/per year ￥ 19000 CNY/per year

materials.text: A photocopy of passport2-inch ID photoHighest Degree Certificate and Official TranscriptChinese Language Proficiency Certificate (for programs offered in Chinese)Two Recommendation LettersCertificate of Guardianship (age under 18)Non-criminal Record issued within 6 monthsBank StatementHealth Examination Report within 6 monthsApplicants currently in China should provide photocopy of your Residence Permit and a performance statement issued by your previous schoolApplicants are required to pay the application fee of RMB500 within the prescribed time in accordance with the requirements of the pre-admission offer.

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese Nationality or Citizenship in good physical and mental health.2. With a valid foreign passport, they should have completed the study of the previous stage (those who have not graduated while applying must provide the pre-graduation certificate and obtain relevant diplomas before the registration).3. Age of 18 or above. For the applicants under 18, please submit the Certificate of Guardianship. 4. Academic Requirements:Applicants for bachelor degree studies must have high school certificate5. Language Proficiency Requirements:Programs offered in English Good English language proficiency. For those whose native language is not English, please provide score report of English language test (e.g. TOEFL/IELTS/DOULINGO) or proof of previous study conducted in English6. Academic Ability Requirements: Applicants need have good critical thinking and academic potential.
